cells.gaps: EDUSER is established only as a three-week pilot in 20 primary schools of one province (April 2026), with SERNIE staff, not the schools, doing the entry; a national rollout is unfunded and no plan naming the system is held. Kept disagrees: the standing SERNIE register is paper forms keyed in Kinshasa (COD-001, keyed-elsewhere) and the pilot is enrolment by app (COD-002). No national count or share of schools; COD-008 and COD-009 are from the excluded source and set nothing.
cells.note: The digital learner register is at its pilot, which the ladder places at stage 2. Stage 3 needs a register schools fill past its pilot; the national SERNIE record is filled on paper by visiting staff and keyed centrally, with no primary school doing digital input.
